g.text: Complete every private-path check and record all five prior states before setting the first service to Disabled.
PASS requires private IPv4 + TCP 443 for every row
Stored outside the repository before the first update
STOP: incomplete record, failed private check,
or no owner ready to restore access
If the final DNS or TCP check fails,
The order is the control: run connectivity-check, write the complete restore record, then set Disabled.
